title: The Inhibition Mechanism of Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma via LXR Receptors: A Multifaceted Approach Integrating Molecular Docking, Molecular Dynamics and Post-MD Inter-Molecular Contact Analysis.
authors: Agar, Soykan; Akkurt, Barbaros; Ulukaya, Engin
journal: Asian Pacific journal of cancer prevention : APJCP
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过分子对接和动力学模拟探究天然配体对LXR核受体的抑制机制，对象为蛋白-小分子互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: OBJECTIVE: Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) has an unfavorable outlook due to its aggressive characteristics, delayed diagnosis, and limited effective treatment options for advanced stages of the disease. The significant mortality rate has prompted investigations into additional factors that could aid in managing this type of cancer. Liver X receptors, specifically LXRalpha and LXRbeta, are nuclear receptors that oversee the expression of genes related to cholesterol, glucose, lipid metabolism, and inflammatory responses. LXRs have also emerged as potential targets for addressing PDAC, and recent findings have demonstrated that LXR ligands can impede cell proliferation in various cancer forms, notably pancreatic cancer. This comprehensive computational research study involving oncological in silico mechanism discovery explored inhibitory ligands for Liver X receptors (LXRalpha and LXRbeta), which are believed to have prognostic significance in PDAC. METHODS: The study utilized Baicalein, Beta-Sitosterol, Polydatin ligands in molecular docking and dynamics and post-molecular Hydrogen bonding contact analyses dynamics to characterize receptor inhibition. RESULT: The outcomes suggest that Baicalein exhibits versatile inhibitory effects on both receptors, while Beta-Sitosterol emerges as a highly effective inhibitor of LXRbeta. CONCLUSION: Further in vitro and in vivo investigations will be beneficial and would shed light onto the mechanism to decipher the suppression of PDAC evaluating the potential of Baicalein, Beta-Sitosterol, Polydatin natural ligand compounds.
abstract_zh: 目的：胰腺导管腺癌（PDAC）因其侵袭性特征、诊断延迟以及晚期疾病有效治疗选择有限而预后不良。其显著死亡率促使研究人员探索有助于管理此类癌症的额外因素。肝X受体，特别是LXRalpha和LXRbeta，是调控与胆固醇、葡萄糖、脂质代谢及炎症反应相关基因表达的核受体。LXRs也被视为治疗PDAC的潜在靶点，近期研究结果表明，LXR配体可抑制多种癌症形式（尤其是胰腺癌）中的细胞增殖。这项涉及肿瘤学计算机模拟机制发现的综合计算研究，探索了被认为在PDAC中具有预后意义的肝X受体（LXRalpha和LXRbeta）的抑制性配体。方法：本研究利用黄芩素、β-谷甾醇、虎杖苷配体进行分子对接和动力学分析，以及分子后氢键接触分析动力学，以表征受体抑制。结果：结果表明，黄芩素对两种受体均表现出多效性抑制作用，而β-谷甾醇则成为LXRbeta的高效抑制剂。结论：进一步的体外和体内研究将有益，并有助于阐明抑制PDAC的机制，评估黄芩素、β-谷甾醇、虎杖苷天然配体化合物的潜力。
